item.title: Went on a few hour drive outside of Vegas
item.description:
Saw some cool places
Been wanting to get away and see what is outside but still near to Vegas so took the 95 through some towns
Had a personal tour by myself with the guide. They no longer book for investigations and are selling the place so I got lucky to go inside for a few hours. I heard and experienced nothing. It was still very cool and the lady who took me through the place was very knowledgable.
I love cemetaries and reading epitaphs. Their is such a somber peace I love.
This one made me really sad...poor girl
There were free range donkeys y'all... FREE RANGE
And I went through Gemfield and picked up some cool rocks
FREE RANGE DONKEYS
The tackiest tourist attraction in tonopah
Love little diners
FREE RANGE
I really loved the cow's expression and wanted this mug but it was pricey
The 3 hour drive was stunning and breath-taking and it was the most fun I've ever had in years even more fun and stress-free than any time I was in France. Being alone is truly a blessing. I now know no one can bring me joy or peace better than I can do myself. I want to disappear and live in a ghost town one day where no one will find me or know me or bother me and I will just serve coffee and cake and open and close when I want. I want to leave this life behind and start over away from the internet and city. Just a place of my own, a shack by the road, a coffee pot, a bed, and a dream of simple solitude.

item.title: GovBrief Today #665
item.description: On Thanksgiving, Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum accused Donald Trump's drug agency of interfering in her country. The DEA had posted tip lines the night before asking Mexicans to anonymously report cartel members and corrupt officials. Sheinbaum asked how Washington would react if Mexico set up a WhatsApp number for reporting American corruption, and said the agency has plenty of work at home. Then she read aloud from an Associated Press investigation that found it watched at least 1.4 million fentanyl pills move through six states without seizing them. The same day in Ottawa, Elizabeth May, a member of Canada's Parliament, presented a petition signed by nearly 290,000 people. It asks Prime Minister Mark Carney to expel Trump's ambassador, Pete Hoekstra, for interfering in Canadian politics. Last month the American embassy he runs accused Canadian politicians of meddling in the midterms. May said Hoekstra would be happier living in another country and wished him a happy Thanksgiving. On February 1, 2025, I typed a list of nine things I never imagined a government doing in one day and sent it to my family. I've sent one every night since: 10,109 stories over 665 straight nights, free and without ads. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I'll send it to you too. Subscribe free: https://gbounacos.substack.com/subscribe NEW: Trump's DC Makeover maps 17 places Donald Trump has renamed, rebuilt, remade, or proposed changing in his second term, most of them in Washington, and shows where each one stands today.
